artifact_or_test_id: dashboard_lib._parse_progress_log and collect_activity; 2423a requirements and acceptance criteria
command_or_fixture: dashboard_lib._parse_progress_log and collect_activity; 2423a requirements and acceptance criteria
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: True progress dates and distinct navigable document cards, with the original event stream preserved.
known_bad_detection_method: A date-only filter still admitted 2027-01-01 from the wrong table; a unique operation over the ten returned events produced only one card.
limitations: Readiness exercised current behavior and fixture feasibility. The corrected endpoint and live card still require verification.
observed: Using the real dashboard_lib progress reader, a future calendar date in a separate evidence table was returned as if it were a progress update. With 12 entries from one spec and one from another, collect_activity returned ten of the first spec and dropped the other. AC-1 and AC-2 require both facts to change while preserving legitimate events. AC-3 checks the live click path.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

artifact_or_test_id: 2423a AC-1 through AC-3; historical 1x8e1; independent code review, QA and adversarial primer.
command_or_fixture: 2423a AC-1 through AC-3; historical 1x8e1; independent code review, QA and adversarial primer.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: True progress dates and distinct navigable document cards, with the original event stream preserved.
known_bad_detection_method: Replaying the old parser on 1x8e1 recovered the exact screenshot's skip_idle_summary_validation heading; the 12-to-one example killed the UI-only alternative.
limitations: Review establishes plan coverage. Actual dashboard navigation and card uniqueness will be exercised at delivery.
observed: The primer traced all ten bogus dates to the historical mutation table. Code and QA independently demonstrated dated evidence leakage and losing the second document when grouping after truncation. All proposed checks cover the admitted spec and wave Objective, including same-day ordering, existing event callers and exact-path navigation. A DOM-only filter cannot recover discarded documents. This bounded read-only change needs no new dependency or write permission.
proposition: council-readiness approves the current affected scope

artifact_or_test_id: DashboardActivityTests; 1x8e1 and 1wscp archived documents; Node Activity component click/Enter simulation
command_or_fixture: DashboardActivityTests; 1x8e1 and 1wscp archived documents; Node Activity component click/Enter simulation
counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: True progress dates and distinct navigable document cards, with the original event stream preserved.
known_bad_detection_method: Before the product edit I observed the same-date flood displacing the second document and the parser admitting a date-shaped mutation row; the two controls now reject those outcomes through the collector.
limitations: These independent checks use the real component under a minimal element factory. Parent is separately verifying the running dashboard.
observed: DashboardActivityTests ran five tests. I parsed reported archived files directly: 1x8e1 returns three genuine updates, all 2026-09-05, and 1wscp returns 27 dated through 2026-09-03. With two concrete source paths sharing one change ID and sixteen tied updates followed by an older update, collect_activity kept both cards, chose update 15, and preserved the ten repeated event rows. Exercised the actual JS Activity component with independent mismatched event and card inputs: click and Enter passed their respective document paths.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

command_or_fixture: Parse the 1p9bn archived spec; compare with the identical text with its escaped pipe replaced by a placeholder.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: A latest update contains a Markdown-escaped pipe.
expected: The final same-day implementation entry supplies the card.
known_bad_detection_method: Compare the current 1p9bn latest card to its source table. Substituting a neutral placeholder for the escaped pipe restores the genuine later row.
limitations: Corpus comparison covers current archived records on this checkout.
observed: Nineteen real dated rows include escaped pipes. Five documents would show an earlier card. For 1p9bn the card shows Planned as the latest update.
proposition: An escaped Markdown pipe in an update must remain part of its cell.
public_path: collect_activity via parse_change_doc on real progress tables

disposition_rationale: AC requires the latest genuine row. Extend the existing parsing fix to preserve escaped cell separators.

command_or_fixture: Compare current _parse_progress_log on 1p9cf, 1sbfl, 1tmb4, 23p9t and 237eh with legacy pipe splitting. Inspect each dropped source date and update.
counterexample_or_failure_condition: A dated update in the Progress Log contains a backtick escape or an unpaired backtick. All column separators are otherwise unambiguous.
expected: The five genuine progress entries remain visible.
known_bad_detection_method: The unmodified tokenizer loses five canonical dated records; restoring delimiter splitting when width is unambiguous reveals them again.
limitations: Compared tracked local wave records. Tests do not run against a downstream checkout.
observed: Counts fell by one file-by-file on the first repair. For example 1p9cf lost its July 1 implementation note and 23p9t lost its November 18 delivery repair note.
proposition: Typed legitimate updates must remain in the event feed when they contain Markdown source examples or literal backticks.
safety_and_authorization: Read-only local fixtures and historical source inspection.

disposition_rationale: The admitted event compatibility contract includes these existing rows; preserve them on the dashboard path.
